item.text:
**Overall:** mostly yes, but incomplete. Lula’s 2024 record shows several concrete pro-equality actions for women, Indigenous and quilombola communities, and poorer regions. The main counterevidence is that Black Brazilians, poor communities, and LGBT+ people still faced serious structural violence/discrimination that his government did not eliminate.

- [Discurso do presidente Lula no evento à margem da Assembleia Geral das Nações Unidas “Em defesa da democracia: lutando contra o extremismo”](https://www.gov.br/g20/pt-br/documentos/discursos/discurso-do-presidente-lula-no-evento-a-margem-da-assembleia-geral-das-nacoes-unidas-em-defesa-do-extremismo) - Governo do Brasil / G20 - 2024-09-24 - Lula said democracy must protect diversity, pluralism, and rights defenders, and he explicitly condemned racist, xenophobic, misogynistic, and anti-minority narratives. Question IDs: 4B.7.

- [Lula vê lentidão nas conquistas das mulheres, diz que participação na política não pode ser favor do governo](https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/03/08/lula-ve-lentidao-nas-conquistas-das-mulheres-diz-que-participacao-na-politica-nao-pode-ser-favor-do-governo.htm) - Reuters via UOL - 2024-03-08 - Lula framed women’s participation in politics as a right, not a favor from government, and highlighted the low number of women in cabinet. Question IDs: 4B.7.

- [Governo federal lança plano com 79 ações para promover a igualdade salarial e laboral entre mulheres e homens](https://www.gov.br/mulheres/pt-br/central-de-conteudos/noticias/2024/setembro/governo-federal-lanca-plano-com-79-acoes-para-promover-a-igualdade-salarial-e-laboral-entre-mulheres-e-homens) - Ministério das Mulheres - 2024-09-18 - The government launched a 79-action plan, with budgeted interministerial measures to reduce discrimination in the workplace and promote women’s access, permanence, and promotion. Question IDs: 4B.7.

- [Lula diz que é "insanidade" projeto sobre aborto que pune vítimas com mais rigor](https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/06/15/lula-diz-que-e-insanidade-projeto-sobre-aborto-que-pune-vitimas-com-mais-rigor.htm) - Reuters via UOL - 2024-06-15 - Lula rejected a bill that would punish rape victims more harshly than the rapist, saying that treating women that way was “insanity” and should be handled as a public-health issue. Question IDs: 4B.7.

- [Minha posição sobre marco temporal não mudou, sou a favor dos povos indígenas, diz Lula](https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/09/12/minha-posicao-sobre-marco-temporal-nao-mudou-sou-a-favor-dos-povos-indigenas-diz-lula.amp.htm) - Reuters via UOL - 2024-09-12 - Lula reiterated opposition to the “marco temporal” doctrine and said he stood with Indigenous peoples’ territorial and cultural rights, despite congressional resistance. Question IDs: 4B.7.

- [Governo Federal destina mais de 120 mil hectares a 4,5 mil quilombolas](https://www.gov.br/igualdaderacial/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/governo-federal-destina-mais-de-120-mil-hectares-a-4-5-mil-quilombolas) - Ministério da Igualdade Racial - 2024-09-19 - Lula delivered land titles to quilombola communities, resolving a decades-long territorial claim and strengthening political inclusion for a historically excluded Black rural group. Question IDs: 4B.7.

- [Governo Federal promulga Política Nacional para fortalecer desenvolvimento regional e reduzir desigualdades no país](https://www.gov.br/mdr/pt-br/noticias/governo-federal-promulga-decreto-para-fortalecer-desenvolvimento-regional-e-reduzir-desigualdades-no-pais) - Ministério da Integração e do Desenvolvimento Regional - 2024-03-26 - Lula signed a regional-development policy meant to reduce intraregional and interregional disparities, which is the clearest evidence I found on political equality for poorer or less powerful regions. Question IDs: 4B.7.

- [Brazil: Mixed Rights Record for Lula’s First Year](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/brazil-mixed-rights-record-lulas-first-year) - Human Rights Watch - 2024-01-11 - HRW said Lula made progress on women’s rights and other rights, but still had not adequately addressed chronic police abuse that disproportionately affects Black Brazilians. Question IDs: 4B.7.

- [World Report 2025: Brazil](https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2025/country-chapters/brazil) - Human Rights Watch - 2025-01-01, covering 2024 events - HRW reported 4,565 police killings by September 2024, with more than 80 percent of victims Black, and said prosecutions remained very limited. This is strong counterevidence that political equality in practice was still badly violated for Black Brazilians. Question IDs: 4B.7.

- [Brazil: Freedom in the World 2024 Country Report](https://freedomhouse.org/country/brazil/freedom-world/2024) - Freedom House - 2024 - Freedom House said Brazil still struggled with disproportionate violence against and economic exclusion of minorities, while societal discrimination and violence against LGBT+ people remained serious problems. Question IDs: 4B.7.

Search gap: I did not find strong 2024 evidence that Lula personally imposed arbitrary loyalty tests, party capture, or explicit exclusion of opposition regions/viewpoints. The negative evidence is mostly structural inequality, racialized policing, and persistent discrimination rather than a clear Lula-led campaign against minorities or dissenters.
